sources.text: Cyclic stress reduces fatigue endurance in metal beams.
Photosynthesis converts sunlight into stored chemical energy.
Osmosis moves water across a selectively permeable membrane.
Entropy measures the number of microscopic configurations.
Quicksort partitions an array around a pivot.
Recursion solves a problem through smaller instances.
A mutex serializes access to shared mutable state.
Deadlock requires competing processes to hold resources.
Database indexing accelerates selective row retrieval.
Transactions commit changes atomically or roll back.
Market volatility describes variation in asset returns.
Inflation changes the purchasing power of money.
Bonds expose holders to duration and credit risks.
Diversification reduces concentration in a portfolio.
Bayesian inference updates prior beliefs using observations.
Bootstrap resampling estimates sampling uncertainty.
Regression fits relationships between observed variables.
Confounding can bias observational causal estimates.
Diffusion spreads particles down concentration gradients.
Catalysis alters reaction pathways without net catalyst consumption.
Oxidation involves the loss of electrons.
Isotopes have equal proton counts and different neutron counts.
An orbit is shaped by gravitational attraction.
A telescope collects light from distant sources.
Seismic waves reveal properties inside Earth.
Erosion transports surface material through wind or water.
Alliteration repeats initial consonant sounds.
A metaphor describes one thing through another.
Counterpoint combines distinct melodic voices.
Harmony concerns relationships among simultaneous pitches.
